example.title: London Mills Bridge, Knox County Highway 39 over the Spoon River
example.place: London Mills, Fulton and Knox Counties, IL

brief: Village river bridge of 1883: a 130 ft, eight-panel (16.25 ft) pin-connected Pratt through truss with eyebar chords, 13 ft clear roadway on a wooden plank floor and 20 ft truss height, carried on two coursed-stone piers, plus a 27.5 ft Pratt pony-truss approach span on the south and (originally) a 100 ft run of five 20 ft steel I-beam trestle spans on the north, later replaced by fill. Lattice railing inside the trusses; latticed portal with a plate; 6-TON load-limit and hazard boards at the portals. Leads straight into the edge of a small river village, with bare riverbank trees and a muddy bank.
